path.description: Where it is served under the site's root: `/`-separated, with no leading `/` and no `.` or `..` segment. `x/index.html` is served at `x/` too.

parts.description: The file, split over blobs in order, each no larger than its PDS takes. None for an empty file.

sha256.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file.

contentType.description: The `Content-Type` it is served with, such as `text/html; charset=utf-8`, or else the type its path's extension names. Its blobs are `application/octet-stream` whatever it holds.

check.description: The dev.knotless.check, in its runner's account, of the run that built and deployed it. A reader trusts it only from a runner the repository names, and only once it has passed at `commit`.

files.description: What the site serves, by distinct paths.

commit.description: The hex object ID of the commit the files were built from.

fallback.description: The path of a file in `files` served, with status 200, for a page no file has, as a single-page app routes in the browser: a request asking for `text/html`, or for a path whose last segment has no extension. Taken before `notFound`; anything else missing gets `notFound`.

notFound.description: The path of a file in `files` served, with status 404, for a path no file has.

main.description: Kept in the repository owner's account, keyed by the `key` of the dev.knotless.repo whose site it is, so a repository has one site. Each deploy replaces it, and the blobs only the old one named are freed. Deleting it takes the site down. Readers check every file against its `sha256`.

part.description: One blob of a file, in order.

description: A repository's website: the static files served at `https://<owner>.knotless.page/<repo>/`, and the commit they were built from.
